newsitem.title: PERU: Peru hostage crisis draws eccentrics.
newsitem.headline: Peru hostage crisis draws eccentrics.

text.p: Four days into Peru's hostage crisis, eccentrics joined reporters, police and family members on Saturday outside the Japanese embassy residence hoping to win attention for their unusual ideas.
One middle-aged man entertained journalists staking out the scene by yelling verses from the Bible as photographers buzzed around him.
Unshaven and wild-eyed, he forecast eternal damnation for both those within the residence where Marxist guerrillas were holding about 340 captives, and those outside.
"We are all damned, for the Lord said it would be so!" he shouted.

Another younger man, barefoot and clearly drunk, moved among aid workers as they prepared to take much-needed food and water to the building. Clutching a large Peruvian flag he shouted: "Long live the Republic!".
The man's patriotic message was lost on police, who quickly escorted him out of the area.
